nodes.label: Table fragment of years 1916-1923 (two numeric columns: mostly constant 22, second column increasing 36-41)

Annual tabular series 1916-1923: first column near-constant at 22 (1919 reading ambiguous, possibly 21), second column strictly increasing 36,37,38,39,39,40,41; semantics of columns (e.g. day/month or day/offset of an annual astronomical event) uncertain from crop alone
